commits.messageBody:
Mirror server-fork ad4d5c7f. Retain Win32 assembly; use explicit x64 SSE arithmetic, CPUID and prefetch intrinsics. Keep grouping, fourth-lane evaluation and sequential alias behavior.

The stock Win32 oracle has a confirmed cross-asm-block register-clobber bug. Native disassembly and a six-build tiny probe discriminate it; the separately named reload diagnostic, not stock, matches x64 finite/subnormal/extreme/discarded-lane cases in 33,280 records per Debug/Release run. Exceptional NaN differences remain. No arithmetic-helper callers were found; no gameplay or universal bit-identity claim.

(cherry picked from commit 8cdd61ed5b373c4766d107cdad31925309bec21b)
commits.messageHeadline: math: provide x64 SSE intrinsics for legacy Windows helpers

commits.messageBody:
Mirror server-fork 1cc02f6a. Preserve Win32 assembly, add grouping and read-before-write alias behavior; unaligned SSE loads do not assume extra Transform alignment.

Native v120 actual-TU Debug/Release probes record 1,024 cases each, stock Win32 equal to candidate. All 768 finite records and alias/control checks match x64; Debug is exact throughout. Release retains 464 NaN-payload word differences in 136 exceptional records. The strict comparator records that failure rather than claiming general bit identity. Normal startup dispatch and client scenes remain open.

(cherry picked from commit 631c79266695e4cdffada33b954033b965fed0de)
commits.messageHeadline: math: implement the x64 affine transform SSE kernel

commits.messageBody:
Mirror server-fork 517d80bd. Use SQRTSS for the existing rounded float input on Windows x64; keep the Win32 FSQRT path and subsequent reciprocal unchanged.

Actual sharedCollision builds pass all four native v120 configurations. Debug/Release production-TU probes each match all 8,192 sampled outputs, line-twist classifications and MXCSR words against PC64 Win32; candidate Win32 stays identical. The separately recorded x87 status has no x64 counterpart. This is bounded evidence, not complete collision or gameplay acceptance.

(cherry picked from commit 1a2d514b6a44c4a30badfec959db5a526d4fc767)
